notes: TR-XT is a modular robotic-camera control system: a 19"x3RU joystick control panel, a 22" LCD touch screen, and a 19"x2RU "TR-XT Computer" electronics unit that hosts the physical rear I/O documented here (per the manufacturer's own system diagram). rackUnits reflects the 2RU computer/electronics chassis; the separate control panel is 3RU and is not itself a connector-bearing rack unit. The datasheet names connections by protocol only (no labeled rear-panel photo), so several connector shells are inferred rather than confirmed: RS422/232 Automation and Router-control ports are shown as DB-style serial (assumed rs422, switchable to RS232 per spec sheet — physical shell not pictured); GPI/O for on-air tally/router is assumed to be a terminal block (euroblock) — common for broadcast GPIO but not confirmed; USB link to the touch screen is assumed USB-A, exact version/type unstated; AC inlet is assumed a standard IEC C13/C14 rack inlet for a ~200W unit — not explicitly pictured. Ethernet may be single or dual port depending on configuration; link speed (100M/1G) is not stated, so no grade was set. DVI link type (single/dual-link) is not stated. HD-SDI/SD-SDI video-capture input was graded sdi-hd as the highest explicitly confirmed tier (no 3G/6G/12G mentioned in the datasheet).

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: Single or dual Ethernet (config-dependent); connects panel/computer to the Shotoku control network. Link speed not stated.

ports.name: Video Capture In (HD-SDI/SD-SDI)
ports.note: Accepts HD-SDI or SD-SDI for preview/capture; no 3G/6G/12G mentioned.

ports.name: Automation I/F (RS422/232)
ports.note: Serial automation control, switchable RS422/RS232 per datasheet; also offered over IP. Physical connector shell not pictured in datasheet.

ports.name: Router Control (RS422/232)
ports.note: Serial router-control interface, switchable RS422/RS232; also offered over IP. Physical connector shell not pictured.

ports.name: GPI/O (On-Air Tally / Router)
ports.note: GPI in/out used for on-air tally and router control. Datasheet names it by function only; terminal block assumed and unconfirmed.

ports.name: DVI Out (Touch Screen)
ports.note: Drives the 22" touch-screen display per the system diagram; single/dual-link not specified.

ports.name: USB (Touch Screen)
ports.note: Carries touch input from the 22" touch screen back to the computer per the system diagram; exact USB type/version unstated.

ports.name: AC Power In
ports.note: 100-240 VAC 50/60Hz, ~200W. Exact IEC inlet variant (C13/C14) not confirmed by datasheet.
